description: Filter, sort and page the domains listed for sale by their DNS-verified owners; each listing has a fixed price, the appraisal with its range and a buy link. Set mode to changes to get listings listed, changed or removed since a cursor, and poll that instead of re-searching. Use ask_domain_market instead to search from a plain sentence, and quote_domain_purchase for the live terms of one listing. Reads live inventory, runs no appraisal and changes nothing. No matches returns an empty list.

acceptsOffers.description: true returns only listings that accept offers; false returns only fixed-price listings.

cursor.description: For mode changes: the cursor from the previous reply. Omit it for the last 24 hours.

maxLength.description: Maximum length of the name, 1 to 63 characters.

maxPriceCents.description: Maximum fixed price in US cents.

minPriceCents.description: Minimum fixed price in US cents.

mode.description: search (default) filters live inventory. changes returns listings listed, changed or removed since cursor.

q.description: Part of the domain name to match.

tld.description: Suffix without the dot, such as com or io.

name: search_domain_listings

outputSchema.description: mode search: listings, count, total, nextOffset. mode changes: events, cursor (send back), hasMore.

items.description: Appraisal fields are null when the seller listed by DNS with no appraisal.

title: Search domains for sale
